subject: Taxes
title: Tax Loss Harvesting in Crypto
description: One-minute skill: Tax Loss Harvesting in Crypto.

hook.text: Unlike stocks, crypto has no wash sale rule. You can sell Bitcoin at a loss, immediately buy it back.

buildup.text: Stock traders must wait 30 days to rebuy after a loss sale.

discovery.text: This loophole lets crypto investors harvest losses to offset gains without ever changing their portfolio.

twist.text: Congress has proposed closing this loophole since 2021.

climax.text: The wash sale gap shows how crypto exists in a regulatory halfway zone—partially taxed, partially free, fully confusing.

punchline.text: Sell at a loss, buy it right back.

quiz.question: What is unique about crypto tax loss harvesting compared to stocks?
options: No wash sale rule—you can immediately rebuy after selling at a loss
